title: Monday
player_goal: Reach the office by 9:30 using Maps.
design_goal: Navigation across pockets, autos as three temperaments (haggle / meter / Kannada puzzle), lateness as a cost, the first key item, the workday as a reusable time jump. The office interior is never shown.

cast.role: No ID, no entry → Admin block
'Spell it.' Issues the ID card (key item)
Branches on on_time_first_day / late_first_day; evening line after the workday
Appears at the gate after the workday (requiresFlag act1_first_day_done); shares number → met_sameer

beats.what: Maps shows the Office pin and the route. Walk the Whitefield street to the auto stand (three autos) or walk the whole way.
Three autos, three temperaments. Any deal pays and the exit zone takes you (transit auto, card 'Auto → Office'). Walking is free and slow.
beats.reroute: no auto → walk; late → stress + Divya's remark

beats.what: Office gate arrival zone sets office_arrived → officeClockIn reads the clock: ≤ 09:30 'Made it.' else 'Divya noticed.' (+10 stress). Guard → Prakash ('Spell it.') → ID card → Divya.
The office door is a workday trigger: fade to black, [skyline time-lapse card — art pending], clock 09:30 → 18:00, food −20, first-day stress +5, autosave.
18:00 outside the gate: Sameer says bye, and a lanky intern in an HIVR lanyard is on the phone — 1.2 begins at once.

assets_needed: office_gate pocket render on its real streets (tech-park gate, guard cabin, admin block door, auto stand, shuttle bay) — needs the user's references (ADR-30) and the real spot
skyline time-lapse card (landmarks doc: Nandi Hills parallax)
sheets: three auto drivers, guard, Prakash, Divya, Sameer, Ravi
acceptance: Maps routes from Prashanth Layout to the Office pin
each auto resolves as written and the exit charges nothing extra
arriving after 09:30 sets late_first_day, +10 stress, and Divya's late line plays; before, her on-time line
Prakash's card adds id_card and the guard's line changes
the office door jumps the clock to 18:00 with food −20 and autosaves
Sameer and Ravi stand at the gate at 18:00 and 1.2 can be played immediately
